title: Time slows and God speaks on the night train from Zurich to Vienna, at age 40
place_text: Night train from Zurich to Vienna

tellings.difference: Stresses God standing there and being aware, and does not mention the route or his age.
tellings.link_reason: This is the guest's own experience of God's presence on a train, the same as his night-train encounter between Zurich and Vienna.

plain: A former CIA chief named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen says that at age 40, on a night train from Zurich to Vienna, time seemed to slow down and God was there, aware and standing with him. He says God told him: "do not criticize my church, the old and the new are one." He says he wrote the message down by hand, and he links it to his Bible from West Point, the US Army's military academy.
